SOC Chat App v1.0.4 - Admin Panel Enhancement:
- Fixed group chat display names showing as 'Unknown'
- Enhanced admin panel with comprehensive CRUD operations
- Implemented Quick Actions in admin dashboard
- Added Export Data, View Logs, Backup Database, and System Cleanup features
- Fixed messages showing 'No Text' in admin panel
- Added sender name resolution for all messages
- Enhanced notification system with Socket.IO authentication
- Improved admin panel with complete database control capabilities
